title: F.E.A.R. 2: Project Origin
notes: Vault reads your save games and never touches the game. The game saves at the start of every level, so finishing an episode pops its achievement as the next one starts.
Episodes count from any save, so old saves count too. Only the furthest level matters, not the difficulty.

testGuide.title: Start the campaign
testGuide.detail: Play until the first checkpoint. "Last save" should show Sanctuary.

testGuide.title: Finish the first episode
testGuide.detail: When the next level starts, "Complete: Sanctuary" should pop up.
